myths.heard: Lagos don cap rent — landlord can't increase am anyhow again.
myths.heard_en: Lagos has capped rent — landlords can no longer raise it.
myths.fact_en: Neither the current law nor the bill caps rent. Your remedy today is to ask the Court to declare an increase unreasonable.
myths.fact_pcm: The law wey dey and even the bill no cap rent at all. Wetin you fit do today na to go Court make dem declare say the increase too much.

myths.heard: Agent fee don cap — some papers talk 10%, some talk 5%.
myths.heard_en: Agent fees are now capped — reported as 10% by some outlets, 5% by others.
myths.fact_en: There is no fee cap in force. The 5% figure (of one year's rent) is in the bill, which is still at committee. The 10% figure matches neither the law nor the bill.
myths.fact_pcm: No fee cap dey work now. The 5% (of one year rent) na inside the bill, and the bill still dey committee. The 10% wey some papers talk no dey inside the law or the bill at all.

myths.heard: Landlord no fit collect pass 3 months rent upfront again.
myths.heard_en: Landlords can no longer collect more than 3 months' rent upfront.
myths.fact_en: That 3-month cap is the bill, not the law. Today's caps: 1 year for a new tenant, 6 months for a sitting monthly tenant — in force since 2011.
myths.fact_pcm: That 3-month cap na the bill talk am, e never be law. Wetin dey work today: 1 year for new tenant, 6 months for sitting monthly tenant — since 2011.

myths.heard: The Tenancy Law protects every tenant for Lagos.
myths.heard_en: The Tenancy Law protects every tenant in Lagos.
myths.fact_en: It does not apply in Apapa, Ikeja GRA, Ikoyi or Victoria Island, or to institutional housing. The bill would remove the area exemptions — but it is not law yet.
myths.fact_pcm: E no cover Apapa, Ikeja GRA, Ikoyi and Victoria Island, and some special housing. The bill wan remove that exemption — but e never be law.

myths.heard: If tenant dey owe, landlord fit lock the place abi remove door.
myths.heard_en: If a tenant owes rent, the landlord can lock the place or remove the door.
myths.fact_en: Never — arrears or not, self-help eviction is a crime today (fine up to ₦250,000 or 6 months). Only a court order ends possession. The bill would raise the fine to at least ₦1,000,000.
myths.fact_pcm: Lai-lai — whether you dey owe or not, to lock tenant outside na crime today (fine reach ₦250,000 abi 6 months). Na only court order fit end your stay. The bill wan raise the fine go at least ₦1,000,000.
